solution.methodName: Fraction to percent: make the bottom 100

steps.action: Percent means out of 100, so make the bottom 100.
steps.why: A percent is a fraction with 100 on the bottom. For example, 30% means 30/100.

steps.action: 5 × 20 = 100, so multiply the top and the bottom by 20.

trapNotes.35%: This just writes the 3 and the 5 side by side. Change the fraction so the bottom is 100.
trapNotes.6%: 3/5 = 6/10, but that is 6 out of 10, not 6 out of 100. Out of 100 it is 60.
trapNotes.0.6%: 3/5 = 0.6 as a decimal. To change a decimal to a percent, multiply by 100 (move the point two places right).
